sample_inclusion: male PanK4 WT and PanK4 mKO mice, 28 weeks old, glucose-injected 40 min before euthanasia (S4.1.1.4.p1); no exercise arm in the RNA-seq experiment
primary_estimand: Genotype effect (PanK4 mKO vs WT) on gastrocnemius gene expression under glucose injection, used to check BCAA-catabolism genes (S2.6.p5, Fig. S9A-C). The paper's exercise data (Fig. 1A-C, Fig. 4E-H, Fig. S7) are phosphoproteomics, Western blots and glucose uptake, not transcriptomics.
planned_contrasts: PanK4 mKO vs PanK4 WT (S2.6.p5; paper reports no DEG count, only 'no significant alterations in genes encoding enzymes related to BCAA catabolism')
normalization: StringTie FPKM (S4.1.1.4.p1); GEO deposits prepDE.py read counts
paper_results: No DEG count stated; BCAA catabolism genes not significantly altered (S2.6.p5, Fig. S9A-C, supplementary data 2)
